method: Built-in image_gen paintings, five newly generated and seven reused from the original text-free print-v2 set. These files contain ONLY illustrations, not mastheads or lettering.
artDirection: Twelve distinct late-90s games-mag cover subjects: pinball, city, industrial explorer, coaster, hoverpod, dungeon, space launch, robots, hover racing, critters, boy band and cosy winter. Native typography stays crisp at every size. Interior editorials/reviews/adverts reuse the issue's relevant key art; guide, postbag and comic use separately generated paintings.
encoding: 320px-wide aspect-preserving WebP, quality 0.72; full covers typeset at384x512 by PrintArt.magazine.

assets.prompt:

The entire image must be original hand-painted gouache/airbrush artwork with visible brushwork, broad strong shapes and matte printed1990s colours. Square illustration only, no borders. No lettering of any kind, no logos, no words, no symbols on any object, no brands or familiar characters. The title will be added later outside the image. All important shapes central75%, legible at320px.
